result.summary: The page is largely well-formed: the header, search bar, category chips, restaurant cards, and bottom navigation align cleanly. The main visual defect is the promotional banner, where white text sits on a pale mint background and is nearly unreadable. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were treated as intentional and not reported.

issues.description: The promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint green background. The contrast is far below WCAG minimums, so the offer and promo code are hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (for example the dark green or near-black used elsewhere) on the mint background, or darken the banner background so white text meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
